topic: Echoes of Freedom: Khadi Spinning Guilds
short_description: Celebration of hand-spun cotton and its economic and spiritual role in modern India.
body:
Echoes of Freedom: Khadi Spinning Guilds

Khadi is not just cloth; it is a thought. The solar charkhas of today trace their DNA directly back to Wardha and Sabarmati.
seo_title: The Legacy of Indian Khadi & Hand-Spun Cloth | Heritage Pulse
seo_description: Historical and ecological review of the khadi spinning tradition.
